label: Value Arc Ticks
author: Conky-Studio
description: Arc made of discrete ticks that light proportionally to Value — between continuous arc gauges and segmented rings.
lua_draw_body:
local cx, cy, R = {cx}, {cy}, {radius}
 local n = math.floor({tick_count} + 0.5)
 local min_v, max_v = {min_value}, {max_value}
 local span = max_v - min_v; if span == 0 then span = 1 end
 local pct = ((tonumber({value}) or min_v) - min_v) / span
 if pct < 0 then pct = 0 elseif pct > 1 then pct = 1 end
 local lit = pct * n
 local fr, fg, fb = {color}
 local tr, tg, tb = {track_color}
 cairo_set_line_cap(cr, CAIRO_LINE_CAP_ROUND)
 cairo_set_line_width(cr, {line_width})
 for i = 0, n - 1 do
  local a = math.rad({start_angle} + {sweep} * (i / (n - 1)))
  local on = i < lit
  if on then cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, fr, fg, fb, {opacity})
  else cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, tr, tg, tb, {opacity} * 0.6) end
  local x1 = cx + math.cos(a) * (R - {tick_length})
  local y1 = cy + math.sin(a) * (R - {tick_length})
  local x2 = cx + math.cos(a) * R
  local y2 = cy + math.sin(a) * R
  cairo_move_to(cr, x1, y1); cairo_line_to(cr, x2, y2); cairo_stroke(cr)
 end
